summary: Private Austrian stainless stockholder (76 M EUR); we are 0.35 %. Sole active source for 1.4301 sheet, but 70710 is qualified (0 % quota): a credible switch. Nickel and alloys bought forward to January 2027, so falling market prices are 'not our reality'. Contract already has an AS-14301 clause (45 %). Owner offered open-book costing; moves above 2 % need its pricing committee. Push with 70710 and its own cost shares, not market falls.
notes: Fears losing the sheet to qualified 70710; needs its forward cover priced in until Jan 2027. Note: hedged, yet its price is down 20.6 % since the first price under the index-clause contract and renewals. Delivery excellent (OTD 96-100 %), so quality is no lever.
fears: market prices below its forward cover
